deadline.value: January 1 application deadline for Fall Semester
deadline.quote: The deadline for applications is January 1st.

gre_general.value: Department no longer requires or accepts GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Geology no longer requires or accepts GRE scores; do not include these scores in any part of your application.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Geology / Earth Science subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants work directly with prospective faculty advisor and request fee waiver recommendations through them.
supervisor.quote: Applicants for graduate studies may request a waiver of the application fee, and they should work directly with their prospective faculty advisor. Applicants requesting a waiver should prepare their application online and ask their prospective advisor to send a short (2–3 sentences) recommendation of the request to the Director of Graduate Studies.

funding.value: Entering graduate students are supported by departmental teaching or research assistantships.
funding.quote: All applicants are considered for Research Assistantships, which provide a tuition waiver and a stipend.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from four-year bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: A four-year bachelor’s degree, a three-year bachelor’s plus a master’s degree, or a three-year bachelor’s plus completion of first year of the master’s program from a recognized institution by the Association of Indian University (AIU) or All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).
